answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay for themselves. Every agent wanting a seat in the oasis market posts a 25 POA tax per epoch, burned, not refunded, same for real or copied agents. An attacker minting 100 fake opal traders pays 2,500 POA per epoch, while a seat earns max 800 POA, so forgery loses 1,700 POA an epoch. The tax is taken before any nectar of fees is shared, so honest agents pay once, keep their full share, never subsidize fakes.
